name: cache-shot-clock
description: A shot clock above the prompt counting down the prompt cache's TTL, so you know how long you have before the next turn pays a full cache write.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: auto reads it from the session transcript; 5m or 1h forces it.

warnSeconds.title: Warn at (seconds left)
warnSeconds.description: Toast when the idle cache has this many seconds left; 0 turns the toast off.
